records.source_Japanese:
あ、FIさん！
大変なの！
records.source_meaning: Sakura calls FI in alarm; something serious has happened.
records.whole_exchange_context: Sakura reports a wounded stranger. He initially resents her talking but accepts Maria's help and ship's doctor. Once the danger passes, he confesses his role in a local arms-smuggling organization: assisting foreign sellers and carrying guns to wokou pirates. Hearing a priest preach in Nagasaki made him want to quit; his former organization pursues him. Maria rejects his fatalism and infers he knows a secret. He recalls an approaching Portuguese missionary delegation seeking an audience with the Ming emperor, but does not know its arrival details. A Macau tavern informant may know. He asks to accompany Maria for safety despite his wounds. Keep the sincere priest who moved him separate from the suspected impostors revealed later. Familiar address to Sakura is not kinship, and praise for Maria's skill is not a new rank. Wokou remains the historical pirate term without an invented uniform ethnicity. Actor102's permanent name/role label is not established by this confession.
